title: What's the creepiest thing that happened to you that you still can't explain?
comments: I was home alone and heard my mom call my name from the kitchen. As I was heading there, my mom called me from her room and whispered: don't go, I heard it too.
Woke up to my dog growling at the closet. Opened it. Nothing. Next morning, the closet door was open again and my shoes were neatly lined up facing the bed.
